properties.name: Hot Springs of Trelvik
properties.note: A geothermal springs with naturally heated water that provide relaxation and medicinal benefits. Average temperature is 86°F.

properties.name: Laugardur — white sand mining town
properties.note: Laugardur is a mining town of 6155 people just nearby the white sand mine.

properties.name: The Golden Cat
properties.note: A big and famous roadside tavern. Delicious baked hart with white brandy is served here.

properties.name: The Major Tavern
properties.note: A big and famous roadside tavern. Delicious jugged deer with sweet juice is served here.

properties.name: Kordaldalese Lighthouse
properties.note: A lighthouse to serve as a beacon for ships in the open sea.

properties.name: Rolafsfjor Battlefield
properties.note:
A historical battle of the Nelahlidian Conflict. 
Date: June 1, 536 Celi Era.

properties.name: Ruined Sacred site
properties.note: Ruins of an ancient sacred site. Untold riches may lie within.

properties.name: Ruined Mausoleum
properties.note: Ruins of an ancient mausoleum. Untold riches may lie within.

properties.name: Bifting Library
properties.note: A vast collection of knowledge, including many rare and ancient tomes.

properties.name: Hoyavikka Melee
properties.note: Warriors from around the land gather for a melee of might in Hoyavikka, with fame, fortune and favour on offer to the victor.

properties.name: Findur Fair
properties.note: A fair is being held in Findur, offering local wood, vinegar, and preserved food alongside foreign goods and services.

properties.name: Ogurkogar Cavern
properties.note: The Ogurkogar Cavern. Locals claim that it is endlessly deep and unexplored.
